== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Am’haranai, also known as the [[Consultants]], are an ancient order of hidden counselors whose origins predate the [[Imperial]] era. Defined by a philosophy of anonymity and the denial of individual identity, they are dedicated to a life of service conducted from the shadows. Their name translates to 'hidden counselors' in an ancient tongue, reflecting their role as a group that maintains influence and intelligence throughout the [[Aurelian Empire]]. While some perceive them as allies to the [[Regents]] in their pursuit of independence, they are also known as a legendary order of assassins for hire. Members often follow strict codes of allegiance, pledging to protect the organization's goals and serve their clients faithfully. The Am’haranai are organized into various specialized groups, such as the [[Architects]] and [[Gardeners]]. Their leadership is comprised of a High [[Council]] that serves as the voice of the organization and leads the [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]]. Historically, members have been inducted from those who showed great aptitude after being freed from Elder control. To facilitate their missions, they have utilized specialized mounts like [[Waveriders]]—creatures bred for stealth and speed that travel across water. Their traditions include specific burial rites involving weapons and black garments, as well as a preference for complex, concealed locations like the [[Gray Island]]. Throughout history, they have been known to take contracts from various powerful figures and entities.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Am’haranai is an ancient order of killers for hire that predates the [[Imperial language]] and existed before the first [[Gardener]]. Historically, this group utilized [[Waveriders]] as mounts and was established with members buried alongside their weapons and blacks. Known also as the [[Consultants]], they possess eyes and ears across the [[Aurelian Empire]] and maintain secret laws that prevent non-human entities from joining the [[Council of Architects]]. Their long history includes a shroud symbol dating back over two thousand years and original secrets that [[Councilors]] once attempted to suppress. [[Shera]] eventually swears an oath of secrecy to protect this order.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Am’haranai are an ancient order that predates the existence of [[The Empire|the Empire]]. Members of this group must swear absolute obedience to their leader and are known to hide in the shadows like liars and criminals. Their tactical capabilities allow a squad to successfully infiltrate groups of servants. Ultimately, the Am’haranai are a group that [[Bastion]] is specifically designed to defend while performing his duties.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A squad of [[Am’haranai]] could infiltrate servants.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Am’haranai|Am'haranai]] order requires members to swear absolute obedience to their leader.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Am’haranai]] existed before [[The Empire|the Empire]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7" />}}</li>
